name: What is the difference between traditional and synthetic stucco?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional and synthetic stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional: cement-based 3-coat (heavier, more durable); synthetic: acrylic one-coat (lighter, flexible, faster).
